home.faq_desc: Everything you need to know about MFCT, donations, and 100% transparency.
home.faq_card_desc: Every donation is tracked with UTR verification and delivered directly to the needy without middle-agent commission.
home.faq1_q: How is MFCT different from other fundraising platforms?
home.faq1_a: We operate on 0% platform fees and every case is verified on the ground by the Mohalla Committee.
home.faq2_q: Does 100% of my donation reach the beneficiary directly?
home.faq2_a: Yes, emergency medical funds go directly to hospitals and Nikah/ration items go directly from vendors to beneficiaries.
home.faq3_q: Will I get an 80G tax exemption receipt for my donation?
home.faq3_a: Yes, an official 80G receipt is issued immediately upon entering your PAN number.
home.faq4_q: Can I give my Zakat through these campaigns?
home.faq4_a: Yes, campaigns marked 'Zakat Eligible' are given 100% as per Shariah only to eligible beneficiaries.
